shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,220p' AGENTS.md; sed -n '1,240p' app/Navigation.tsx; sed -n '1,220p' package.json; find node_modules/next/dist/docs -maxdepth 3 -type f | sed -n '1,120p'"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,260p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/04-linking-and-navigating.md; rg -n \"from ['\\\"]next/link|<Link|href=.?/(blog|products|support)|Navigation\" app components src 2>/dev/null || true; find app -maxdepth 3 -type f -not -path '*/.*' -print | sort"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,220p' app/page.tsx; sed -n '1,220p' app/layout.tsx; rg -n \"More Pages|Navigation links will go here|/blog|/products|/support\" . -g '"'!node_modules/**'"' -g '"'!package-lock.json'"' -g '"'!pnpm-lock.yaml'"' -g '"'!yarn.lock'"'; git status --short; git log --oneline -5 -- app/Navigation.tsx app/page.tsx 2>/dev/null || true"
/bin/bash -lc 'npx tsc --noEmit; git diff --check -- app/Navigation.tsx; git diff -- app/Navigation.tsx'
